{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm no commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Check the full unique values again
print('\nUnique values in revenue:')
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:20])"}
